why: This is a study-specific student-perception survey instrument, not a reusable instructional element.
name: 66-item mixed-methods survey instrument combining ASPECT and Blended Learning Questionnaire items with free-text definition questions
product_description: A researcher-built 66-item questionnaire for surveying pre-clinical medical students' perceptions of and participation in active learning, combining items from ASPECT and the Blended Learning Questionnaire with demographic and free-text questions.
